value.value: Electron-donating thiocarbonate substituents accelerate conversion; ortho substitution inhibits it. The 2,6-xylyl 1j precursor is much slower than p-tolyl 1c. Less-reactive precursors generally yield larger CdS nanocrystals, with partial yields also influencing size.
